section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
label: Corporate tax [national]
value: 0% on taxable income up to AED 375,000, 9% above; 0% on the qualifying income of Qualifying Free Zone Persons; 15% minimum effective rate (domestic top-up tax) for multinational groups with revenue of €750 million or more from 2025; natural persons only above AED 1,000,000 of business turnover; Dubai: 20% tax on foreign banks (corporate tax deducted). Paid by companies and other juridical persons, natural persons in business above the turnover threshold, and non-residents with a permanent establishment in the UAE. Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022, Art. 3; Cabinet Decisions No. 116 of 2022, No. 49 of 2023 and No. 142 of 2024; Dubai Law No. 1 of 2024.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property charges; income tax, pensions, VAT and gratuity are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: Ministry of Finance: Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022 on the Taxation of Corporations and Businesses and its amendments (consolidated English text, v13.1.26; amended by Decree-Laws 60/2023, 40/2024 and 28/2025)

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
label: Tax on branch profits and distributed profits [national]
value: none: no branch profits tax; 0% withholding tax on UAE-source income of non-residents; dividends from UAE companies are exempt income for the receiving company. Paid by no one (the withholding rate is 0%). Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022, Art. 11(5), 12(3), 22 and 45.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property charges; income tax, pensions, VAT and gratuity are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.

value: none for expatriates: the pension schemes cover UAE nationals (employees: 11% insured, 15% employer) and GCC nationals under their own country's law; a GPSSA scheme for self-employed UAE nationals is under review. note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property charges; income tax, pensions, VAT and gratuity are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
